All 278 local symbolic and finite checks passed; continuum proof is analytic.

value.rationale: An exact admissible alternating step-ratio frontier for a newly optimized implicit four-step method directly addresses deployment of variable-step stiff solvers. Its novel structural point is that a frozen step is unstable even though noncommuting two-step dynamics is stable; it supplies both the threshold and boundary eigenstructure, a non-routine cubic rather than extrapolating a simpler two- or three-step result.
